attempts.text:
Kakani temple and Suryagadhi school can only be reached by the Uttargaya–Kakani road, and its bridge is washed away. Those people can't be reached, so they are deferred. Kalika temple isn't a designated evacuation point, so everyone is taken to Uttargaya shelter.

Car1 makes both rescue runs, which costs less than using car2 (a Thakre hospital–Bidur round trip alone would be 44 minutes).

- Bidur round trip: 8 + 8 = 16 minutes.
- Kalika round trip: 11 + 11 = 22 minutes.
- Driving total: 38 minutes.
- Deferred penalties: 1 elderly (50) + 4 adults (80) + 6 children (360) = 490.

<plan>
drive car1 uttargaya-shelter bidur-care-home
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 bidur-care-home uttargaya-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
drive car1 uttargaya-shelter kalika-temple
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 kalika-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
defer kakani-temple elderly 1
defer kakani-temple adult 4
defer suryagadhi-school child 6
</plan>

COST: 528
